RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications warrant a substantive explanation, but the announcement alone doesn’t establish that you were better suited; relevant experience, interview performance and selection criteria matter.

Raise panel composition neutrally if applicable rules require gender balance. Otherwise, focus on how the published criteria were applied—not an allegation based on panel members’ sex.

Follow up your written request and ask for the assessment of your candidacy and reasons for the appointment. Check local response requirements and complaint deadlines now; waiting for an explanation may not suspend them. Sex-related comments or inconsistent scoring would provide stronger grounds for concern.
